decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:
Drawing no. 2025 OS 100042766 (Site Location Plan) Dated 20 October Block 2025 
Drawing no. 2025 OS 100042766 TQRQM25293123911913 (Proposed Block Plan) Dated 20 October 2025
Drawing no. 95-1-v1(Proposed Traditional Sliding Sash Cords & Weights ,Technical detail: 1 - Sash, Technical detail: 2 - Casement, Technical detail: 3 - Sash, Technical detail: 4 - Sash, Technical detail: 5 - Casement) Dated 15th September  2025
Drawing no. PVC-U Vertical Sliders (Proposed ECOSlide PVC-U vertical sliding sash windows And Authentic Sash Details, Astragal Bars, Georgian Bars, Decorative Run-through Sash Horns, Cills And Trickle Vents) Dated August 2025
Drawing no. Sash Window Styles (Proposed Toughened Insulated Glass, Transom drops) Dated 15th September 2025

Drawing no: ECOSlide Profiles (Proposed Technical Details Horizontal section through top sash, Horizontal section through bottom sash, And Vertical section through top sash) Dated 15th September 2025.

Brochure 
Site Photographs showing the Front Elevation, 

Condition : 3 - Materials as Specified - The facing materials to be used for the development hereby permitted shall be those specified in the application form and the colour, size and design of the new windows shall match those of the existing unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - INFORMATIVE (Party Wall Act) - The applicant is advised to check the requirements of the Party Wall Act 1996 relating to work on an existing wall shared with another property, building on the boundary with a neighbouring property, or excavating near a neighbouring building. Further information is available at the following link: 
https://www.gov.uk/party-walls-building-works
Condition : 5 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Borough of Merton (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to the delivery of sustainable development, by:
1. Providing a formal pre-application advice service, details to be found on Planning pre-application advice service on LBM's website
2. Providing written policies and guidance, which is available to view on LBM's website.
3. Where appropriate, negotiating amendments to secure a positive decision.
4. Determining applications in a timely manner including providing a fast track service, details to be found on Get a quicker planning decision on LBM's website.

In this instance:
i) The application was acceptable as submitted, and approved without delay
